description: Held-out set v3, written blind on 2026-10-09 by a separate Claude agent that had no access to the code, the repository or the earlier sets: it was given only a black-box description of the product, the date rules and the expectation schema. Its date arithmetic was checked before the run and nothing needed correcting; no item was changed. Written after the Claude router was added and before either router was run on it. Relative dates are anchored to 2024-12-31 (a Tuesday).

items.query: can you recommend a good lasagna recipe that feeds six people?
items.notes: Cooking request, has nothing to do with the news data.

items.query: Thanks, that was really helpful! Unrelated, but who wrote Pride and Prejudice?
items.notes: Thanks followed by a trivia question. Neither part should query the database.

items.query: Can you pull up everything you have on event 1184527391? I saw it referenced in a report.
items.notes: 10-digit numeric ID inside a longer sentence.

items.query: what's the story behind MX-20240822-PRO-DEMAND-1201938475
items.notes: Mexico fingerprint. The date inside the fingerprint should not turn this into a date search.

items.query: I need the full details for CA-20240415-ASS-ARREST-1168340027, specifically who was involved.
items.notes: Canada fingerprint followed by a follow-up clause.

items.query: What were the most covered stories across North America in October?
items.notes: 'Most covered' wording. The month has no year, so it means 2024.

items.query: Show me the hottest events of March 12, 2024
items.notes: 'Hottest' for a single written-out date. It should not become a daily brief.

items.query: Top stories in Ontario during Q4?
items.notes: Province plus a quarter.

items.query: Give me a recap of what happened on Dec 3rd
items.notes: Abbreviated month with an ordinal day.

items.query: What happened on 3/15/2024?
items.notes: US M/D/YYYY date format.

items.query: Could I get a digest of the news from July 4?
items.notes: A holiday date with no year.

items.query: Give me an overview of Québec between April and June
items.notes: Accented French name for the province, with a range written as two month names.

items.query: What's the situation in CDMX this month?
items.notes: Abbreviation for Ciudad de México. 'This month' means December 2024.

items.query: How has Arizona been doing in Q1?
items.notes: US state plus Q1.

items.query: I'd like a general overview of British Columbia
items.notes: No time given, so the full dataset.

items.query: Were there fewer protests in Chicago in August than in July?
items.notes: The later month is named first. Periods must still be ordered earlier first.

items.query: How did violence in Sinaloa change between Q1 and Q2?
items.notes: Quarter vs quarter in a Mexican state.

items.query: Is there more unrest in NYC this month compared to last month?
items.notes: 'This month' vs 'last month' resolved from the reference date. Periods must be ordered earlier first.

items.query: Did arrests in Florida rise in January?
items.notes: The comparison period would be before 2024. The plan should fall back to an events search for January with a notice.

items.query: Compare demonstrations in Ottawa from 2024-02-01 to 2024-02-15 versus 2024-03-01 to 2024-03-15
items.notes: Two explicit ISO date ranges.

items.query: Anything notable in Toronto over the past 10 days?
items.notes: 10 days ending 2024-12-31, inclusive.

items.query: what went on in Los Angeles yesterday
items.notes: Yesterday is 2024-12-30. Step type is left open (daily_brief or events are both plausible).

items.query: Show me police clashes in Mexico last week
items.notes: Last week is the Monday-to-Sunday week before the reference date.

items.query: Any protests in Montréal this week?
items.notes: This week is cut short by the end of the data, so the plan needs a notice.

items.query: Strikes in Michigan on February 30
items.notes: Impossible date. The plan should add a notice and fall back to the full year.

items.query: What happened in Texas in March 2023?
items.notes: The year is outside the dataset. The fallback date range is not defined by the rules, so it is not checked.

items.query: Find reports of wildfire evacuations in Alberta
items.notes: Topic and keyword search with no time, so the full dataset.

items.query: Any kidnapping or hostage-taking incidents in Tamaulipas during September?
items.notes: Event type plus a Mexican state plus a month.

items.query: Show me diplomatic meetings involving Canada and Mexico
items.notes: Two countries as actors, no time given.

items.query: Look for coverage of the women's march in Washington
items.notes: 'march' looks like a month but is not a date, so the range must stay the full year.
